collegeFullAddress: Lakhamsi Napoo Road, Near Matunga (Central Rly), Matunga East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400019
collegeInfo: Prin. L. N. Welingkar Institute of Management Development & Research, popularly known as WeSchool, is a top B-school in India accredited by NBA and NAAC. It offers innovative PGDM programs with focus on design thinking, management, and entrepreneurship. WeSchool is highly ranked for its quality placements and industry partnerships.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Awarded to students with excellent academic performance and demonstrated financial need.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Eligible students may apply post-admission through the student portal; selection is based on academic and financial documents.

events.eventFullDescription: The annual convocation is a grand ceremony celebrating the achievements of graduating students. Industry leaders, alumni, and faculty come together to confer degrees and motivate the new batch for a successful career.

WeInnovate is the annual flagship event on campus fostering creative thinking and entrepreneurship. Students present innovative ideas, prototypes, and business models to corporate leaders and potential investors.

collegeName: Welingkar Institute of Management Development & Research

infrastructure.infraDescription: WeSchool Mumbai campus features state-of-the-art classrooms, IT-enabled learning spaces, a library with 40,000+ books and e-resources, design and innovation labs, auditoriums, gym, cafeteria, and Wi-Fi campus. Hostel accommodation is available for both men and women.
